title: Volusia County Council, District 1 (runoff)
what_it_does: Volusia County Council members set the county budget and millage, adopt land-use rules and oversee county services; the council is nonpartisan.
verified_ballot_note: Runoff per WNDB News Daytona Beach.

candidates.name: Don Dempsey
candidates.occupation: Attorney in DeLand (criminal defense, family law, civil litigation); former Volusia County assistant state attorney
candidates.background: Incumbent District 1 council member; advanced to runoff (Melissa Thorne eliminated).
candidates.primary_result: Second in Aug 18 primary; trailed Anderson by over 3,000 votes

taxes.summary: At the County Council's final budget hearing on Sept. 22, 2026 he voted for the rolled-back general-fund rate of 3.1007 mills, saying he had reconsidered his earlier vote for a flat rate and now favored full rollback. The council reached rollback by cutting about 70% of the law library program budget and transferring $4.8 million in one-time money from economic-development reserves.

sources.title: Volusia County Council adopts rollback rate for general fund, cuts funding for law library program

property_tax.summary: Says he will vote yes on Amendment 3 and would make up the lost revenue with budget cuts.

sources.title: 2026 Voter's Guide - Volusia County Council District 1 runoff (News 6 / News Collaborative of Central Florida)

candidates.name: Wendy Anderson
candidates.occupation: Environmental science educator, scientist and consultant; supervisor, Volusia Soil & Water Conservation District
candidates.background: Anderson describes a 35-year career as a teacher, scientist, consultant and administrator in environmental systems and natural resources conservation. She led the August 18, 2026 District 1 primary with 47.6% of the vote, short of the majority needed to win outright, and advanced to a November 3 runoff against incumbent Don Dempsey. Her campaign centers on conservation land, flooding and redevelopment inside existing urban areas.

taxes.summary: No public position found as of Sept 2026.

property_tax.summary: In the News 6 voter guide questionnaire she said she will vote no on the proposed constitutional amendment to sharply cut property taxes, saying it would shift the tax burden onto recent homebuyers, renters and small businesses while centralizing power with state government.

sources.title: 2026 Voter's Guide - Volusia County Council District 1

housing.summary: She would promote redevelopment inside urban areas with a wider range of housing types, including tiny homes and multi-family structures, and supports incentive programs for first-time homebuyers purchasing older homes that need renovation, plus compact, walkable mixed-use communities.

environment.summary: She names land-use change causing habitat loss and aquifer depletion as the county's biggest environmental problem, and says she would protect taxpayer-funded conservation lands and prioritize green space that absorbs rainwater.
